## Assessment Objectives Coverage

### AO1: Knowledge with Understanding (50%)
- Covered throughout all chapters
- Key definitions, facts, laws, and concepts

### AO2: Handling Information and Problem-Solving (30%)
- Worked examples in each chapter
- Practice questions requiring application
- Data analysis exercises

### AO3: Experimental Skills and Investigations (20%)
- Practical investigations in each topic
- Notes to Physics Practical Work section
- Laboratory safety guidelines

*This mapping ensures complete coverage of the Cambridge IGCSE Physics 0625 syllabus for 2026-2028.*
